about: Notre-Dame-des-Prairies is a city in Lanaudière, Quebec, immediately north of Joliette—not a Prairie-provinces community, and not Joliette itself. Suburban neighbourhoods, the L’Assomption River corridor, and remaining meadows on Joliette’s edge define this small city. About 9,000 people live in Notre-Dame-des-Prairies.
